# Adhd Care

This folder catalogs the complete set of national clinical quality indicators managed by the Danish ADHD-DATABASEN to monitor ADHD assessment and treatment pathways. The metrics track process adherence—such as the timeliness of somatic assessments, diagnostic conferences, and psychoeducation—as well as long-term educational outcomes like primary school exam completion. Collectively, these pages expose severe systemic shortfalls and regional disparities in meeting the established 90% development targets, particularly regarding cross-sectoral coordination, adult psychotherapy, and standardized diagnostic procedures.

## Pages

- [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] — Tracks the completion of somatic assessments within 120 days for the ADHD assessment population.
- [[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]] — Measures clinical environmental observations within 120 days for children aged 0–5 undergoing ADHD assessment.
- [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] — Evaluates the use of manualized diagnostic interviews or environmental observations within 120 days for youth aged 6–17.
- [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] — Monitors the holding of diagnostic conferences with a child and adolescent psychiatry specialist within 120 days of assessment initiation.
- [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] — Tracks cross-sectoral coordination, specifically contacting the patient's home municipality within 120 days of assessment start.
- [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] — Measures the initiation of ADHD-related psychoeducation for patients or parents within 120 days of treatment start.
- [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] — Records the proportion of treatment pathways where patients receive pharmacological ADHD treatment.
- [[indikator-7a|Indikator 7a]] — Tracks the proportion of youth in the ADHD assessment population who pass the primary school leaving exam before age 17.
- [[indikator-7b|Indikator 7b]] — Measures the primary school exam pass rate before age 17 specifically for the ADHD treatment population.
- [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] — Evaluates the initiation of ADHD-related psychoeducation within 120 days for adult patients in treatment.
- [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] — Monitors the provision of psychotherapy within one year for adult patients where it is deemed clinically relevant.
- [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]] — Tracks the assessment of social support needs within 120 days for adults in the ADHD treatment population.
- [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] — Measures the initiation of pharmacological treatment within 120 days for adults starting an ADHD package course.
